statement.zh: **标准**：保护非联邦系统中的受控非密信息（SP 800-171 Rev.3）（Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations (SP 800-171 Rev.摘要首句同时给出受文者、力度与对象：「This publication provides federal agencies with recommended security requirements for protecting the confidentiality of CUI when the information is resident in nonfederal systems and organizations.」次句把适用面收到组件一级：「The requirements apply to components of nonfederal systems that process, store, or transmit CUI or that provide protection for such components.
statement.en: **Standard**: Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations (SP 800-171 Rev.3) (保护非联邦系统中的受控非密信息（SP 800-171 Rev.3）).

statement.zh: 缺口写在第 1 节的因果链里：责任不因共享而转移，「The responsibility of federal agencies to protect CUI does not change when such information is shared with nonfederal organizations.」于是需要等价保护，而等价保护有硬前提：「To maintain a consistent level of protection, the security requirements for safeguarding CUI in nonfederal systems and organizations must comply with Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 199) publication [6] and FIPS 200 [7].」要求并非新造，而是从控制集裁剪：「The requirements are derived from the controls in NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-53 [8].」与「SP 800-171 security requirements represent a subset of the controls that are necessary to protect the confidentiality of CUI.
statement.en: The gap is laid out as a chain of consequence in Section 1.Responsibility does not move with the data: "The responsibility of federal agencies to protect CUI does not change when such information is shared with nonfederal organizations." Equivalent protection is therefore needed and has a hard precondition: "To maintain a consistent level of protection, the security requirements for safeguarding CUI in nonfederal systems and organizations must comply with Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 199) publication [6] and FIPS 200 [7]." The requirements are not invented but tailored: "The requirements are derived from the controls in NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-53 [8].

statement.zh: 义务层级在编号章节里分得很清。§1.1 划出谁受约束：「The security requirements in this publication are only applicable to components of nonfederal systems that process, store, or transmit CUI or that provide protection for such components.」并指明申说对象：「The requirements are intended for use by federal agencies in contractual vehicles or other agreements that are established between those agencies and nonfederal organizations.」§2.2 为组织定义参数留下的 must 不止一句，动作都落在非联邦组织：正文一句「If a federal agency or a consortium of agencies do not specify a particular value or range of values for an ODP, nonfederal organizations must assign the value or values to complete the security requirement.
statement.en: The wording levels separate cleanly inside the numbered sections.Section 1.1 says who is bound: "The security requirements in this publication are only applicable to components of nonfederal systems that process, store, or transmit CUI or that provide protection for such components." and who invokes them: "The requirements are intended for use by federal agencies in contractual vehicles or other agreements that are established between those agencies and nonfederal organizations." Section 2.

statement.zh: 限度分四层。§2.2 说明每条要求所附讨论的地位：「The discussion section is informative, not normative.」其下一句紧接理由：「It is not intended to extend the scope of a requirement or influence the solutions that organizations may use to satisfy a requirement.」§1.1 排除一类主体：「The requirements do not apply to nonfederal organizations that are collecting or maintaining information on behalf of a federal agency or using or operating a system on behalf of an agency.」§3 承认部分系统套不全：「Some systems, including specialized systems (e.g., industrial/process control systems, medical devices, computer numerical control machines), may have limitations on the application of certain security requirements.
statement.en: The limits sit at four levels.Section 2.2 states the standing of the discussion attached to each requirement: "The discussion section is informative, not normative." with the reason next: "It is not intended to extend the scope of a requirement or influence the solutions that organizations may use to satisfy a requirement." Section 1.1 excludes one class of holder: "The requirements do not apply to nonfederal organizations that are collecting or maintaining information on behalf of a federal agency or using or operating a system on behalf of an agency." statement.zh: 门面板块按本份文本连读为「NIST Special Publication 800 NIST SP 800-171r3」（此处的编号重复是抽取所致），标题行「Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations」，作者行「Ron Ross Victoria Pillitteri」，部门行「Computer Security Division Information Technology Laboratory」，页眉行给出日期「NIST SP 800-171r3 May 2024」；免费获取行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，其后是 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-171r3。出版史块给出评审与取代关系：「Approved by the NIST Editorial Review Board on 2024-04-23 Supersedes NIST Special Publication 800-171r2 (February 2020; Includes updates as of 01-28-2021)」，引用行给出两位作者与年份：「Ross R, Pillitteri V (2024) Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations.
statement.en: Read line by line, this copy prints "NIST Special Publication 800 NIST SP 800-171r3" on the number line (the duplicated identifier is an artifact of the extraction), then the title line "Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations", the author line "Ron Ross Victoria Pillitteri", the division line "Computer Security Division Information Technology Laboratory", and the running head "NIST SP 800-171r3 May 2024", so the date is May 2024; the free-access line reads "This publication is available free of charge from:" followed by the DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-171r3.
